name: Coca-Cola Consolidated - Sandston Sales & Distribution Center, VA

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (37.5108,-77.3446) landed in a residential neighborhood ~1.5 km SW of the real site and roster address (5301 Eubank Rd) is also off. Correct facility is Coca-Cola Consolidated at 500 Eastpark Ct, Sandston/Highland Springs VA (37.5324,-77.3369), confirmed via Nominatim geocode and company press releases describing the 63-acre campus, 300,000 sq ft plant/DC plus a new 210,000 sq ft warehouse.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single private access drive enters the campus from Eastpark Court at the NE corner; campus is fully fenced/tree-buffered with one controlled entrance. No Street View on the private drive, so the exact gate hardware is inferred from layout - rated as a controlled truck gate at medium confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No distinct guard-booth structure visible at the entrance in z20 imagery; the small building near the access drive is a metal utility/office structure attached to operations, not a beside-the-lane booth. guardShack=false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Truck gate present but no guard shack visible -> remoteGs=true (kiosk/badge/app check-in implied). Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~45 total: sawtooth dock canopy on the north face of the west warehouse holds ~30+ doors with trailers backed in; the east warehouse adds another bank of ~10-15 along its east face. Counted from z19 imagery - approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ trailers parked without tractors in the NW drop yard plus a smaller east lot; large fleet of red Coca-Cola Consolidated / Red Classic trailers and bobtail delivery trucks visible.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on physically separate building faces - west warehouse north face (canopy docks) and east warehouse east face - support separate ship/receiving operations.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has 4 distinct buildings: west warehouse, dark dock-canopy structure, central warehouse, and the rail-served manufacturing building.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur with hopper/gondola cars runs into the north edge of the property serving the manufacturing building (concentrate/syrup intake). Confirmed in z20 imagery.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach from the Eastpark Court gate around to the docks easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Richmond metro, immediately adjacent to Richmond International Airport and I-64, surrounded by industrial parks and dense suburban development - Urban.

citations.claim: $50M, 210,000 sq ft warehouse on 63-acre Sandston campus (500 Eastpark Ct), ~450 teammates

verification.rationale: Active Coca-Cola Consolidated production+distribution campus, recently expanded (2024).
